title: Malicious code in statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.shippy (npm)
description: The npm package statist-browser-typed-client-eventea.projects.shippy contains malicious code that compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected computer should be rotated immediately from a different, uncompromised device. Removal of the package alone may not fully eliminate the malicious software or control established by the attacker.
